description.value: KI-ISU is a Japanese restaurant on Marine Drive in West Vancouver offering a wide-ranging menu spanning sushi, sashimi, pressed sushi, Japanese curry, tempura, udon, and donburi alongside specialty rolls and combination sets. It sits on a well-travelled cycling corridor along the North Shore and accepts online orders for in-house pickup. Indoor seating is available, making it a practical refueling stop for cyclists exploring the area.
